DAILY SYNTHESIS Today's dominant thread was a violent rotation out of semiconductors and technology into financials, healthcare, and defense — a classic flight from growth toward value and defensives. The move was not broad market weakness but surgical sector repricing, with crypto-adjacent equities caught in the crossfire of persistent institutional outflows. Tomorrow's setup hinges on whether the semiconductor complex finds a floor or the rotation broadens into a more generalized risk-off unwind.
